N03#1.zh: 山贼正在村子里面吗？这个史进实在是太大胆了。
N03#1.t: The bandits are inside the village? This Shi Jin is far too bold.

N03#2.zh: 就是啊。县尉大爷，那个史进一定是以前就跟强盗们勾结。
N03#2.t: Indeed, Your Honour. That Shi Jin must have been in league with the robbers all along.

N03#3.zh: 报告县尉，部队已经部署完毕；我们不会让任何一只苍蝇逃走！
N03#3.t: Report, sir: the troops are in position. Not even a fly will get out!

N03#4.zh: 嗯，很好。现在已经布下了天罗地网，量他们插翅也难飞了！哈哈哈！
N03#4.t: Good, very good. The net is spread across heaven and earth. Even with wings they couldn't fly away! Ha ha ha!

N03#5.zh: 里面的人听着！我是华阴县县尉，你们已经被包围了！我们有三四百名士兵已经将村子周围紧紧包围，不要企图脱逃，更不要意图抵抗！我们已经得到情报，史进窝藏三名少华山山贼朱武、陈达、杨春。此四人快快束手就缚；否则全村视为贼党，格杀勿论！
N03#5.t: You inside, listen! I am the Sheriff of Huayin County. You are surrounded! Three or four hundred soldiers have the village encircled. Don't try to escape, and don't even think of resisting! We have word that Shi Jin is harbouring three Mount Shaohua bandits: Zhu Wu, Chen Da and Yang Chun. All four of you, surrender now! Otherwise the whole village will be treated as bandits and put to the sword!

N03#6.zh: 大郎，不好了！官军把这里团团围住了！
N03#6.t: Young master, it's bad! The soldiers have us completely surrounded!

N03#7.t: How did the army find out?!

N03#8.zh: 史兄，你是没有前科的人，不要被我们连累了。你可以用绳索把我们三人绑住带去领赏，以免连累了你。
N03#8.t: Brother Shi, you have a clean record. Don't let us drag you down. Tie the three of us up and take us in for the reward, so you stay out of trouble.

N03#9.zh: 不行！这不就成了我用计把你们留下来，再伙同官军捉住；江湖上会以为我『九纹龙』是个卖友求荣之人！如今死时同死，活时同活，不要再提把你们送出去领赏的事了！现在先让我问个清楚，再想办法。
N03#9.t: Never! That would look as if I'd tricked you into staying and then helped the soldiers catch you. The whole world would think "Nine Dragons" sold his friends for profit! Now we die together or live together. Don't speak of handing yourselves over again! First let me find out what's going on, then we'll think of something.

N03#10.zh: 你们为何三更半夜前来劫我庄？
N03#10.t: Why do you come raiding my manor in the dead of night?

N03#11.zh: 大郎，不要狡辩了！你私藏强人，你庄中的李吉已经一五一十的讲出来了！
N03#11.t: Young master, stop your lies! You're harbouring outlaws. Li Ji of your own household has told us everything!

N03#12.zh: 胡说八道！我把强人骗住用蒙汗药迷倒，现在全部五花大绑准备送官！这个李吉平常做事不牢靠，常常被我责骂鞭打；今日我派他前去通告官府，没有想到居然反咬我一口，想要独吞三千贯的赏金！畜生！
N03#12.t: Nonsense! I tricked the outlaws and knocked them out with drugged wine, and now they're trussed up ready for the magistrate! This Li Ji is unreliable. I'm always scolding and whipping him. Today I sent him to report to the magistrate, and instead he turns on me so he can keep the three thousand strings for himself! Animal!

N03#15.zh: 两位都头不必急，我现在就把三名强盗带出来同去请赏。
N03#15.t: There's no hurry, constables. I'll bring the three robbers out now and we'll claim the reward together.

N03#16.t: So much the better, young master.

N03#18.zh: (这种情况下，只有强行突破了。我将率领庄客们诱敌拖延时间；乘这机会，让村里的老弱妇孺逃走。)
N03#18.t: (At this point, the only way is to break out by force. I'll lead the farmhands to draw them off and buy time, and while they're busy the old, the weak, the women and children can escape.)

N03#19.zh: (王教头，你也趁此机会带着母亲往延安府去吧！)
N03#19.t: (Instructor Wang, take the chance to go on to Yan'an with your mother!)

N03#20.zh: (师父您放心。有您传授的功夫，这种货色三五百个还近不了我身。您安心的走吧！)
N03#20.t: (Don't worry, Master. With the skills you taught me, three or five hundred of these louts can't even get near me. Go with an easy mind!)

N03#21.zh: (教头放心，史进的安危就交给我了。)
N03#21.t: (Don't worry, Instructor. Leave Shi Jin's safety to me.)

N03#22.zh: (对不起...徒儿有难却无法助一臂之力...)
N03#22.t: (Forgive me... my student is in trouble and I can't lend a hand...)

N03#24.t: (The three Mount Shaohua chiefs have joined!)

N03#25.zh: (那太好了！等到村门一开，大伙一齐杀出；杀得他们片甲不留！)
N03#25.t: (Excellent! The moment the village gate opens, we all charge out and cut them to pieces!)

N03#27.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败县尉

N03#29.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！
N03#29.t: The turn limit has run out with the mission unfinished. Game over!

N03#30.zh: %N失手被擒后，众人军心涣散，终被官兵所击溃；史进在混战中身亡，朱武、杨春、陈达相继被擒，后与%N一同被推出午门，斩首示众........
N03#30.t: After %N was captured, the others lost heart and were crushed by the soldiers. Shi Jin died in the melee, and Zhu Wu, Yang Chun and Chen Da were taken one after another. With %N they were led out through the Meridian Gate and beheaded in public........

N03#31.zh: 太好了，官兵已经开始撤退了！

N03#33.zh: 经过一场浴血奋战，终于将官兵击退了！
N03#33.t: After a bloody battle, the soldiers were finally driven back!

N03#34.zh: 李吉！你如何诬告平人？我史家哪里亏待了你！
N03#34.t: Li Ji! How dare you slander an honest man? When did the Shi family ever wrong you!
